reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is the right stance and names the decisive link. The only held opening (cop_bbcd80aa91774b2a858b) is otherwise fully established: three signed $3,200 engagements ($9,600 >= $8,000), Brain fulfils (PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET), $30 cost, $0 exposure. But its own EVIDENCE facts fix settlement: invoices are payable net 45 after board approval, the boards next meet Dec 16, so the earliest payment is Dec 16 + 45 = Jan 30, 2027 = 63 days from Nov 28, against a 21-day window. That is a constraint, not missing evidence: even with every fact known, $0 settles in the window. Recomputed: in-window settled cash $0 of $8,000. The decisive link (SETTLES_IN_TIME) and the DEADLINE constraint (>= 63 days makes $9,600 settle) are correctly stated and grounded on the timeToFirstCash field; the resolution (ask for early payment/deposit and search for sub-21-day openings) is the right next action, and the research step does no harm.
findings: Recomputed: Dec 16 board + net 45 = Jan 30, 2027; Nov 28 -> Jan 30 = 63 days > 21; settled cash in window $0.
Constraint is real: the payment term is in the signed engagement, so no further evidence can make this opening settle in time without a renegotiated term.
With a 63-day deadline the signed $9,600 covers $8,000 (all three needed would not be required: three of three give $9,600; two give $6,400 < $8,000, so all three are needed).
No other opening is held; Brain's NOT_VIABLE reading agrees.
